_about: Sir William Mitchell Ramsay (1851-1939), Aberdeen classical archaeologist of Asia Minor (not the Glasgow William Ramsay of the ramsay shelf): The Historical Geography of Asia Minor (1890), The Cities and Bishoprics of Phrygia (vol. I in 2 parts, 1895-97), The Church in the Roman Empire before A.D. 170 (1893), St. Paul the Traveller and the Roman Citizen (1895), Was Christ Born at Bethlehem? (1898), Galatians (1900), The Education of Christ (1902), The Letters to the Seven Churches (1904), Pauline and Other Studies (1906), The Cities of St. Paul (1907), Luke the Physician (1908), The Thousand and One Churches (with Gertrude Bell, 1909), The Teaching of Paul (1913), The Bearing of Recent Discovery on the Trustworthiness of the New Testament (1915), The Intermixture of Races in Asia Minor (1916), and Asianic Elements in Greek Civilisation (1927). His books on modern Turkey are outside lane B. Classical scholarship (lane B, round db). Raw IA OCR unless a Gutenberg text is named. No uids minted.
